newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel renames units to boost image.
newsitem.headline: Keppel renames units to boost image.

text.p: Keppel Group said on Monday it will rename some of its subsidiaries to boost their corporate identity and market positions.
The company said in a statement property developer Straits Steamship Land (SSL) will be renamed Keppel Land Ltd while Singmarine Industries Ltd will be renamed Keppel Marine Industries Ltd.
Steamers Maritime Holdings Ltd will be renamed Keppel Telecommunications and Transportation Ltd (Keppel T&T) to reflect their businesses of shipping, logistics and telecommunications.
Far East Levingston Shipbuilding Ltd (FELS) will become Keppel FELS Ltd to mirror its diversification into power generation and other infrastructure engineering activities.

Its Philippines units, Kepphil Shipyard Inc will be renamed Keppel Batangas Dockyard Inc and Cebu Shipyard and Engineering Works will become Keppel Cebu Shipyard and Engineering Inc. The Singapore listed companies will hold extraordinary general meetings for shareholders to approve the name changes, which are expected to take effect by the end of February 1997, the statement said. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
